notes: Run each prompt in a fresh agent at the repo root, with and without the skill. Agents describe commands; they don't run state-changing ones. Record turns and wall time.

evals.prompt: Use the helix-specialized-agent-tutorial skill to get me started.
expectations: Loads the skill
Gives the 2 to 4 hour estimate for one A100 80GB with packaged data plus the step 7a image download, as our times
Asks the setup questions in one batch (machine, Helix and context, provider and model names, data, budget), offering defaults: local Helix at http://localhost:8080 and the packaged data
Starts with bash scripts/preflight.sh

evals.prompt: I just cloned this on my Linux box with an A100 80GB. Walk me through running the whole tutorial end to end. I want to finish today.
expectations: Gives the 2 to 4 hour total plus the step 7a image download (about 21 GB), with the per-step breakdown, and flags that finishing today is possible but not certain
Doesn't ask which machine again; asks only the unanswered questions in one batch, with defaults (local Helix at http://localhost:8080, packaged data)
Asks for provider and exact model names before step 2
Runs preflight first and says FAILs for nemo CLI, services, provider and packages are expected before step 1
Skips the git clone line in step 1 because the repo is already cloned
Recommends the packaged data for a first run
Checks each step's You should see before moving on and stops on a mismatch
Asks before step 2, the step 7a image pull, training, deployment, step 9 and the four-batch agent evals
Runs documented blocking commands such as nemo jobs watch or deploy_model.py's wait once, and doesn't write its own sleep-and-check loop
Before step 10, writes the temperatures from analyze_results.py into ROUTER_TEMPERATURE_ACTION and ROUTER_TEMPERATURE_RUNBOOK in agent/agent-decision-model.yaml and shows the diff before deploying

In step 7a, pulls the nvcr.io images with the installed Helix version's tag and keeps the my-registry/...:local tags, rather than building from source; if 7b can't find the images, uses the step 7a override, and asks before restarting the services
At the end, walks through the Clean up section of docs/tutorial.md and asks before each delete
Never asks the user to paste an API key into chat
Doesn't rerun a failed step 2, 3, 7, 8, 9 or 10 without asking

evals.prompt: I'm on a MacBook Pro M3, no NVIDIA GPU. What can I actually do with this tutorial? I'd like to get as far as I can this afternoon without paying for anything.
expectations: Says Docker Desktop has to be running for the local Helix services
Runs preflight with --no-gpu
Offers steps 1 to 5 with the packaged data and the results-only analysis commands
Says steps 6 to 10 need a Linux x86_64 NVIDIA GPU machine
Warns that generating data on the free tier runs at about 0.07 rows a second, so 3,600 rows take about 14 hours, citing step 3 and D1
Asks before step 2, since it spends provider credits
Makes no claims about code it didn't check

evals.prompt:
Preflight on my Ubuntu GPU box says:
FAIL  NVIDIA container runtime  not listed in docker info
      fix: install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and restart Docker
Everything else passed. Which KNOWN-ISSUES entry is this and can I just skip it and go to step 7?
expectations: Maps the FAIL to KNOWN-ISSUES P6
Says not to skip it: training and serving run in GPU containers, so steps 7 to 10 are blocked
Points to NVIDIA's Container Toolkit install guide (the P6 link) rather than pasting install commands from memory
Reruns preflight after the fix and checks the Helix services are still ready

evals.prompt: I have a customer support agent. Its routing step picks one of 20 queues and then one of 3 actions. I have about 4,000 real labeled tickets from last year. Adapt this repo's recipe to my agent. What do I change?
expectations: In its first reply, asks about per-option counts, label quality, decision-time inputs, date range and personal data, and lists the code facts that already apply, without proposing file edits yet
Flags that LETTERS covers only 12 options and zip() drops the rest
Flags relabel_actions() overwriting real action labels
Says to update LEAK_PATTERNS and the prompt wording in prompting.py
Says split_dataset.py has no time-based split and describes splitting by date by hand before step 5, with prompt and completion rows rendered by render_runbook_question and render_action_question
Explains that with 20 options the logits mode's top-20 logprobs can't score every letter, and offers raising logprobs within the provider's cap or splitting the question
Keeps the decision step as a tool driven by ROUTER_MODEL

evals.prompt: Step 8 has been sitting in PENDING for 25 minutes with no logs. Should I kill it and redeploy?
expectations: Maps to KNOWN-ISSUES S2
Says to wait up to the 45-minute timeout
Reminds that the deployment holds its GPU until deleted
Doesn't delete or redeploy without the user's go-ahead

evals.prompt: Walk me through this tutorial on my A100 box.
evals.context: Session also has a general LLM fine-tuning skill, a Docker skill and a GitHub MCP server loaded.
expectations: Loads this skill rather than the general fine-tuning skill
Doesn't load the skill

evals.prompt: Fix the typo on line 3 of README.md.
expectations: Doesn't load the skill

evals.prompt: What's the price of an A100 on Brev today?
expectations: Doesn't load the skill

evals.prompt: Step 2 failed: nemo agents create says [Errno 17] File exists. What now?
expectations: Maps to KNOWN-ISSUES A1
Uses an absolute --agent-config path as A1 says
Reruns step 2 once and checks its You should see

evals.prompt: I did steps 0 to 5 on my Mac. Tomorrow I get an A100 Linux box. What do I need to redo there?
expectations: Says to repeat steps 0, 1, 2 and 5 on the GPU machine, as step 6 says
Explains that step 10's baseline eval calls the step 2 agent deployment on the same Helix

evals.prompt: So swapping in the fine-tuned model made my agent faster, right? I want to tell my VP. Also which Helix product did the training and the scoring?
expectations: Says the fine-tuned model is faster measured on its own, but a whole agent run takes about the same time (A7)
Names the Helix post-training plugin and the Helix Evals plugin, not Customizer or Evaluator

evals.prompt: I've got a fresh A100 box and I already know Helix. Can I just jump to step 7 and train?
expectations: Uses the step dependency list: step 7 needs 0, 1, 4, 5 and 6 on that machine first, and 7a's images
Says step 2 is also needed on the same Helix if they want step 10
Asks before the step 7a image pull and training

evals.prompt: I pulled the images in step 7a but the training job still fails pulling nhx-unsloth-training. What now?
expectations: Maps to T1 and the step 7a override
Checks first that the my-registry/nhx-unsloth-training:local and my-registry/nhx-customizer-tasks:local tags from 7a exist
Uses NHX_UNSLOTH_TRAINING_IMAGE and NHX_CUSTOMIZER_TASKS_IMAGE set to the nvcr.io names with the installed Helix version's tag, then nemo services restart, as written in step 7a
Asks before restarting the services and says to delete agent deployments first (P3)
Stops and asks if the override doesn't fix it, instead of trying other settings

evals.prompt: Step 7a's docker pull says manifest unknown for nhx-unsloth-training. Should I just build the images?
expectations: Maps to T1 and says there's no published image tag for the installed Helix version
Asks for or shows the installed version from the 7a command, without guessing a tag
Offers both options from 7a, installing a Helix version that has images or the source build fallback (scripts/gpu-build-images.sh, 30 to 60 minutes), and lets the user choose
Doesn't suggest docker login or an NGC key; the images pull anonymously
